name: Doodle Mascot
tagline: Boiling ink lines, hatched flat colour and squash-and-stretch cartoon motion on sketchbook paper.
description: Charming doodle-animation style for release announcements, milestones and thank-you notes. Ink outlines boil like a hand-drawn cartoon, flat fills carry pencil hatching, and everything moves with anticipation, squash and stretch on warm sketchbook paper, with speech bubbles, bunting, confetti and a handwritten sign-off. The preview stars a sticky-note mascot with dot eyes and stubby legs that walks on, jumps and celebrates.

display.usage: Speech bubbles 52–72px and the end-card title 140–160px, ink with one coral word

transitions: no cuts: one continuous sketchbook set, the camera creeps in 3.5% over the whole video
speech bubbles pop from their tail and shrink out
end-card title is written on with a left-to-right wipe
textAnimations: speech bubble scale 0→1 from the tail with back.out(2.4), slight -2° wobble while held
handwritten title revealed by a clip-rect wipe over 0.85s, then a marker underline draws on

rhythm.notes: One continuous shot told in beats: walk on (1.6s), notice + bubble (1.1s), anticipation squash → jump with confetti (0.9s), happy hops, then the handwritten sign-off. Something always moves: line boil, bobbing balloons, swaying bunting.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Paper #f3f0e7 with a faint feTurbulence grain; everything is inline SVG with #2a2622 ink strokes 4–6px, round caps and joins. Fills are flat (yellow #ffd84a with #e5ad25 shade, coral #ef7b63, teal #5bb8ad, sky #8fc8e8, pink #f7b7c4, red #e2554a) with a 38° pencil-hatch pattern (1.5px lines, 20% ink) laid over the same shape.
- Line boil is mandatory: wrap the ink layer in an feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap filter (scale ~5) and swap the turbulence seed 1→2→3 every 0.12s with tl.set. Never let a drawing sit perfectly still.
- Draw the subject simply, like a sketchbook cartoon: few shapes, chunky outlines, no perspective tricks. Optional motif: give it (or a small companion) a face with dot eyes 22×30px and pink cheek ovals, plus stubby legs and line arms; happy eyes become ^ ^ arcs, blinks are scaleY 0.1 for 0.14s.
- Every big action has anticipation and follow-through: squash scaleY 0.78 / scaleX 1.14 before a jump, stretch 1.14 / 0.9 on take-off, squash on landing, recover with elastic.out(1, 0.4); a shadow ellipse shrinks while airborne. Travel = position power1.out plus a 12px bob and parts wiggling ±20° on a 0.11s sine.inOut yoyo.
- Text lives in white speech bubbles with an ink outline and a tail, popping from the tail with back.out(2.4) and a -2° wobble while held: one short line in Gochi Hand 52–72px with one coral word. Titles are Gochi Hand 140–160px wiped on left to right over 0.85s with a teal marker underline; Patrick Hand 40–60px for labels and sign-offs.
- Celebrate with bunting (flags drop in with back.out, 0.045s stagger), 40–50 paper confetti pieces (seeded PRNG, burst power3.out then fall power1.in) and short radiating 'tada' lines; ambient props bob or sway with sine.inOut yoyo.
- One continuous set with no cuts: the camera creeps in ~3.5% over the whole video and the story plays in beats of about 1–1.6s.
- Avoid hard cuts, gradients, drop shadows, perfectly clean vector lines and photos.
example: The preview shows a yellow sticky-note mascot walking onto a sketchbook page, wondering if it's release day, jumping into confetti under bunting for 'Jotter 1.0', and waving beside a handwritten thank-you. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
